verdict.rationale: The quickstart tells developers to install one of Perplexity's official SDKs for type-safe integration. The first-party perplexity-py GitHub library provides typed request and response definitions, sync and async clients, SSE streaming, automatic retries with backoff, typed API errors, an optional aiohttp backend, and a concrete client.search.create example. OpenAI SDK compatibility via the /v1/responses alias and drop-in base-URL swapping adds further SDK paths. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of SDKs in languages beyond Python (e.g. a TypeScript repo), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
